record.body:
## Description

R7: `dashboard/web/ui/src/api-types.ts` is generated from the server's OpenAPI schema with `openapi-typescript`.
R8: A Python CI check fails when `api-types.ts` is out of date.
R9: The UI imports its API types from `api-types.ts`, and `types.ts` holds no API response shape.
Context: `dashboard/backend/model.py` (1,914 lines) mixes store reads, derivation helpers, view types, and loaders, and parses argv-style strings through `_run(` to mimic the canon CLI. `dashboard/backend/server/service.py` has a stdlib HTTP server (`http.server`) beside the FastAPI app in `app.py`. `dashboard/web/ui/src/types.ts` repeats the API shapes by hand. The canon library (`orchestra/canon`) must not change. Every endpoint keeps its JSON shape through the phase. The web server must start and serve a snapshot after every task.

## Approach

Add `scripts/api_schema.py [--check] [--schema PATH]`: without `--check` it writes the FastAPI app's OpenAPI schema (stable key order, trailing newline) to PATH (default `dashboard/web/ui/openapi.json`); with `--check` it compares the live schema with PATH and exits 1 with a message that names the regenerate command when they differ. Add `openapi-typescript` at an exact version as a devDependency in `dashboard/web/ui` and the npm scripts `api-types` (`openapi-typescript openapi.json -o src/api-types.ts`) and `api-types:check` (regenerate to a temp file and fail on a diff with `src/api-types.ts`); extend the `check` script to also run `api-types:check`. Commit `openapi.json` and the generated `api-types.ts`. Replace the hand-written API shapes in `src/types.ts` with imports from `./api-types` (aliases of the generated schemas are fine; leave UI-only types in `types.ts`). Update every `src/*` import. Wire the Python half into CI by adding a test (or a step in an existing Python CI job, not the `web` job) that runs `python scripts/api_schema.py --check`. Run `cd dashboard/web/ui && npm run lint && npm run check && npm test && npm run build`, then `uv run pytest tests/dashboard/test_endpoint_shapes.py tests/test_ci_workflow.py tests/test_web_gate.py -q` and `uv run basedpyright`. Biome must stay at zero findings (generated files may be ignored in `biome.json`).
